mapper.sql:
( CASE WHEN LOWER(c.login_id) = LOWER(#{keyword.exact}) THEN 3 WHEN c.login_id ILIKE #{keyword.prefix} THEN 2 WHEN c.login_id ILIKE #{keyword.contains} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN LOWER(c.name) = LOWER(#{keyword.exact}) THEN 3 WHEN c.name ILIKE #{keyword.prefix} THEN 2 WHEN c.name ILIKE #{keyword.contains} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN LOWER(c.email) = LOWER(#{keyword.exact}) THEN 3 WHEN c.email ILIKE #{keyword.prefix} THEN 2 WHEN c.email ILIKE #{keyword.contains} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
+ CASE WHEN REPLACE(c.phone, '-', '') = #{keywordPhone.exact} THEN 3 WHEN REPLACE(c.phone, '-', '') LIKE #{keywordPhone.prefix} THEN 2 WHEN REPLACE(c.phone, '-', '') LIKE #{keywordPhone.contains} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
+ COALESCE((SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(k.car_num, ' ', '')) = LOWER(#{keywordCar.exact}) THEN 3 WHEN REPLACE(k.car_num, ' ', '') ILIKE #{keywordCar.prefix} THEN 2 WHEN REPLACE(k.car_num, ' ', '') ILIKE #{keywordCar.contains} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM car k WHERE k.customer_id = c.id), 0) )

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM car k WHERE k.customer_id = c.id AND REPLACE(k.car_num, ' ', '') ILIKE #{carNum.contains})

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.login_id, t.name, t.email, t.phone, t.created_at, t.withdrawn, t.car_nums_csv FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.login_id, c.name, c.email, c.phone, c.created_at, c.is_withdrawn AS withdrawn, (SELECT string_agg(k.car_num, ',' ORDER BY k.id) FROM car k WHERE k.customer_id = c.id) AS car_nums_csv
, AS score
FROM customer c
) t
WHERE t.score > 0
ORDER BY
t.score DESC,
t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT c.id
, AS score
FROM customer c
) t
WHERE t.score > 0
